about: The Ark's behaviour checks in CI (.github/workflows/ark-behaviour-audit.yml, scripts/ark-audit-check.mts). Each limit is the merged ark-release value on 2026-11-11 (877ae2c5, the CI configuration below) with a small slack: they stop a regression, not demand the final targets (docs/ark/behaviour-audit.md). Raise them by hand as the lanes improve the numbers; a deliberate worsening changes the limit in the same PR, with why. `--write` prints today's values.

config.measured: 877ae2c5: flyers 596, circling 0.1%, turns 0.78/min, non-flocking followers 0, never move 760, graze label 28.6%, never grazed 39, amphibians crossing 435, snapped 0, heads near camera 99.8%, predators with prey within 5 m at spawn 162, prey react 97% / flee 63.5% near camera (median 0.2 s), awake all-same 14.1%, always in step 80, distinct 2.08, wrong surface 1.3%, sinking 11; encounters react 61.7%, close flee 56.7%, median 0.1 s, heads turn 81.3%

checks.why: Lane MA3 (2026-11-13, the movement audit): 436 on ark-next 640b0062 -> 384. Deliberate: a waterbird's flights go water to water (before, ducks flew onto land and walked back in), grebes and loons stay on the water, and a duck whose spaced range is a few metres reaches no bank. Ducks, geese and swans now come ashore by swimming to the bank to rest.
